master.title: Better Buses
master.desc: A system where sensors are attached to buses and bus stops to track traffic and delays. A [K3s](https://k3s.io) cluster is defined with a master node and two workers, while [OpenNebula](https://opennebula.io) manages the corresponding VMs. The entire system is hosted by an Ubuntu Server VM on [VirtualBox](https://www.virtualbox.org).

master.title: Distributed Intelligence
master.desc: A quorum-based total order broadcast protocol for distributed intelligence databases. A codebase was integrated with all the logic of the protocols, in particular read/write management and leader election.

master.title: CLIP studies
master.desc: Research project in which a baseline with [CLIP](https://openai.com/index/clip) was provided, with the goal of retrieving images similar to aource image conditioned with some text (e.g. "add smile"). Techniques to improve the model were investigated, such as an adapter on top of CLIP, [CLAY](https://arxiv.org/html/2604.11539v1) and more.

master.title: Autonomous software agent
master.desc: Agent_Perry is a BDI agent which goal is to play the multiplayer game [Deliveroo.js](https://github.com/unitn-ASA/Deliveroo.js), an open source project designed for this assignment. Players need to deliver parcels while reacting to other agents' actions, environment changes and special tiles of the map.

master.title: Dream Spot
master.desc: DreamSpot is an all-in-one platform that, with the help of Artificial Intelligence, will guide the user into creating his/her very personal travel by providing suggestions, feasible modifications and adequate accommodations.

bachelor.title: Greenhouse monitoring simulator
bachelor.desc: A project mainly focused on OOP using C++, leveraging on complex class hierarchies and some design patterns such as Observer and Visitor. It also involves a simple GUI on which monitoring the sensors.

bachelor.title: Music shop database
bachelor.desc: Design and implementation of a database with some requirements on table relations and indexing. In addition, a simple program in C is provided to execute some queries.

personal.title: Complementary
personal.desc: A 3D platformer game in which the player has to alternate black and white platforms and obstacles in order to complete the levels.

personal.title: Up Up Up
personal.desc: A 2D game in which the player needs to jump and stick to small floating islands, trying to go as high as possible.

personal.title: NN for digits recognition
personal.desc: A Neural Network trained on [TMNIST](https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/nimishmagre/tmnist-typeface-mnist) dataset. A GUI allows to save, upload, modify, train and test a model. Finally, a canvas permits you to draw digits that the model is asked to predict.
